descriptor.retrieval_description: Rectangular wooden block with a solid, dry, porous surface and flat lateral faces meeting at sharp 90-degree edges. The intended contact region is clean and uniform across the opposing parallel sides.
descriptor.contact_region: The opposing lateral vertical faces of the rectangular block.
descriptor.visible_surface_condition: Dry, clean, and slightly worn with minor surface grain texture.
descriptor.local_geometry: Flat planar surfaces meeting at distinct right-angled edges.
descriptor.contact_patch_visibility: Clearly visible on the front and back lateral faces.
descriptor.uncertainty: None regarding the visible lateral faces, though the exact friction coefficient of the specific wood finish is unmeasured.
